notes: The revisit chooser's buttons stop being dealt out one at a time. They arrive together on the same fade a tab change uses, because opening the chooser is a screen change and had no business inventing motion of its own for it. And on the tutor's opening screen, "Teach me in English" moves to the top: it is the state the tutor will run in, not one of the ways to start a conversation, and centred with the starters it read as the first item in the list of choices.
